knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The manual forbids connecting the filter or the valve to a pump that can exceed the operating pressure, so the connection is refused.
The manual requires sealant suited to plastic and forbids petroleum-based products. Over-tightening tapered threads is also to be avoided.
An improperly assembled valve can blow off, so the clamp and seal are checked before start-up.

practicalCriteria: Nameplate pressure is read and the pump rating is compared before connection, with the decision stated
Clamp, o-ring and flange alignment are checked and the joint is visually confirmed
Sealant and fittings are checked as suitable for plastic, with no petroleum-based product used
Chemical storage location is observed and recorded against the separation rule
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Installation check record for one supervised installation
Photo of the clamp and port labels where the owner agrees
stopWorkCriteria: Pump connected above the nameplate maximum pressure
Valve installed with an unchecked or unseated clamp
Electrical controls mounted over the filter
